svg.title: Same content, same characters
svg.desc: Two copies of the French sentence C’est, guillemets, vrai, colon, oui, exclamation mark. They look the same, but copy 1 has a straight apostrophe and plain spaces, and copy 2 has a curly apostrophe, a narrow no-break space before the closing guillemet and a no-break space before the colon. fr.normalize brings both to one identical line, stamped fr@6154dd89738a.
